description: Minimal capability for the Reco desktop host. It grants Tauri's core defaults (needed by the webview to run and to listen for worker events) plus the narrowest native-dialog permissions — dialog:allow-open and dialog:allow-save — required for clip import and profile load/save (IMPT-01/05/06). It deliberately does NOT grant dialog:default, and enables no shell, fs, http, or opener plugin: the webview reaches the engine only through the thin app commands, which are always callable because they are app commands, not plugin permissions (D-06; security: Elevation of Privilege, T-03-02).
